decisions.reason: The client replaces the single JST-GH interboard connector-family rule with distinct JST-PH power and JST-GH signal connector families.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: so we could make power one even JST PH (to avoid double lines) and signal ones JST GH

decisions.reason: The source concerns the interboard power and signal connectors, not the separate JST-PH battery connector interface.
The interboard connector-family decision does not change the battery connector's placement, orientation, spacing, or mounting-hole clearance.
The source selects electrical connector families but does not change the power board's dimensions, enclosure fit, mounting constraints, or L-shaped connector form.
Keeping signal connections on JST-GH does not alter the I2C cable length, bus speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The interboard connector-family selection does not change the switched 5V rail's voltage, loads, GPIO control, converter, pull-down, or operating pattern.
